methodology.points: Net option premium captured: (sell_entry - buy_entry) - (sell_exit - buy_exit)
methodology.inr: Points × lot size (NIFTY=65, SENSEX=20), 1 lot per signal
methodology.iron_condor: 4-leg position with both CE and PE spreads; a minority of the premium-selling universe (Iron Condor, Batman Spread) uses 4-leg structures — the rest are 2-leg vertical spreads
methodology.win_day: Calendar day where sum of closed trades net points > 0
methodology.loss_day: Calendar day where sum of closed trades net points < 0

summary.note: Ranked by all-time live net premium points; algos with < min_trades_for_rank closed trades are listed unranked in thin_algos
